description_en: Queries the route entries in a gateway route table
description_zh: 调用ListGatewayRouteTableEntries接口查询网关路由表列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-gateway-route-table-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --gateway-route-table-id vtb-5ts0ohchwkp3dydt20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGatewayRouteTableEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the gateway route table that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询网关路由表列表信息的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway route table to query
parameters.name: gateway_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry in the gateway route table to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的网关路由表中路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

GatewayRouteEntryModels.description_en: The details of the route entries in the gateway route table
GatewayRouteEntryModels.description_zh: 网关路由表中路由条目的详细信息

items.description_en: The details of the route entries in the gateway route table
items.description_zh: 网关路由表中路由条目的详细信息

Description.description_en: The description of the route entry

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

Name.description_en:
The name of the route entry.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
Name.description_zh:
路由条目的名称。

长度为2～128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

NextHopId.description_en: The instance ID of the next hop

NextHopType.description_en:
The next hop type. Valid values:

EcsInstance: ECS instance.
NetworkInterface: elastic network interfaces (ENIs).
Local: local
NextHopType.description_zh:
下一跳的类型。取值：

EcsInstance：ECS实例。
NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。
Local：本地

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the route is available. Valid values:

0: unavailable.
1: available
Enabled.description_zh:
路由是否可用。取值：

0：不可用。
1：可用

NextHopId.description_en: The instance ID of the next hop

NextHopType.description_en:
The next hop type. Valid values:

Instance (default): ECS instance.
HaVip: high-availability virtual IP address.
VpnGateway: VPN gateway.
NatGateway: NAT gateway.
NetworkInterface: secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs).
RouterInterface: vRouter interface.
IPv6Gateway: IPv6 gateway.
Attachment: transit router
NextHopType.description_zh:
下一跳类型。取值：

Instance（默认值）：ECS实例。
HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。
VpnGateway：VPN网关。
NatGateway：NAT网关。
NetworkInterface：辅助弹性网卡。
RouterInterface：路由器接口。
IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。
Attachment：转发路由器

Weight.description_en: The weight of the route entry

Status.description_en:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

Pending: being configured.
Available: available.
Modifying: being modified
Status.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。

Pending：配置中。
Available：可用。
Modifying：修改中

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
